head: d05e1d9

smoke.notes: Second verdict: node smoke.mjs -> PASS 9/9 (exit 0). Both offline, no API key, <5s. teacher.mjs (the only networked module) is never invoked by tests; selftest asserts 'tamper detected', 'tamper localized at exact row', 'restore verifies again'; smoke asserts 'observations are the only collapses', 'sense conservation', 'OPS = 7 CELL-MAPPING opcodes'.

essence: living JEV: rhizome+parametric head, watch-deform-observe-idle-compile-serve, sealed promotion gate

ideas.name: Kinda-both organism (rhizome + vessel head)
ideas.statement: A non-parametric ExoJ rhizome (deformation memory that grows from every judgment) AND a tiny parametric head (deterministic torch-free SGD / qthe prototype growth) on identical soil; the ensemble lambda=0.5 prices the 'kinda both' claim — and the honest verdict of record is that the parametric tissue wins on saturated soil (P-G2/b/c all FAIL).

ideas.name: Idle-time compile (the weaver)
ideas.statement: Idle compute diffs the growth journal, trains challenger heads, runs the jeviter promotion gate, and emits a byte-deterministic weave artifact chain-tipped to the journal — amortising the field's accumulated understanding into the next inference (weave-v2 rides the rhizome sense table).

ideas.name: Serve + escalation economy
ideas.statement: A local JEV endpoint speaking the TypeSafe systemone wire; low-confidence judgments carry escalate=true; the budget-capped escalation organ routes them to the hosted teacher whose answer becomes an observation — the garden grows from every escalation, and gifted compute leaves usage receipts.

ideas.name: Real soil + sealed discipline
ideas.statement: First duty is receipt-chain validation over real quilt-qcells CELL-MAPPING ledgers (16 ledgers, 1418 rows, 7 opcodes) with concentration-statistic anomaly detection (design law (b)); every constant and prediction is sha256-sealed in registration.json before the run, fail-closed.

parts.name: hex lattice substrate
parts.essence: 61-cell hex lattice radius 4; hexDist is the axial distance law; every context maps into exactly one cell.
parts.gate: cell count == 61 at radius 4 (axial formula 3r^2+3r+1)
parts.failure_mode: an off-lattice coordinate would mis-map; prevented because contextCell indexes the built lattice modulo 61

parts.name: canonical byte discipline
parts.essence: sorted-key canonicalJSON, sha256Hex, fnv1a64 (fleet chain basis), r6 epoch quantisation, and a LABELED LCG fallback stream — no wall-clock, no Math.random anywhere.
inputs: any JS value / string / seed hex
parts.gate: no wall-clock or Math.random in any deterministic path (header law of canon.mjs)
parts.failure_mode: byte-nondeterministic weaves would break the JS==Python twin claim (P-G5)

parts.name: context-to-cell pre-registered mapping
parts.essence: contextCell = lattice[fnv1a64(canonical context string) % 61] — the DESIGN.md §4 pre-registered mapping from judgment context to lattice coordinate.
parts.gate: same context string always yields the same cell (pre-registered, deterministic)
parts.failure_mode: re-registering the mapping after growth would invalidate all accumulated memory

parts.name: deform (JEV soft emit)
parts.essence: every judgment event appends an alpha=0.4-weighted (gamma,eta,delta) deformation to the mapped cell; never a definite token; delta defaults to the creative-band centre 0.5.
parts.gate: deform never emits a definite token — only (gamma,eta,delta) masses
parts.failure_mode: a hard write here would collapse the wave and erase the non-collapsing claim

parts.name: observe — the only collapse
parts.essence: an observed outcome (receipt label, teacher answer, human REVIEW) is the only place supervision exists; it appends an 'observe' row and increments the per-context op aggregate.
parts.gate: observations are the only collapses (smoke-asserted)
parts.failure_mode: supervision leaking in anywhere else would make training unauditable

parts.name: hash-chained growth journal
parts.essence: append-only journal; each row_hash = sha256(canonicalJSON([prev, row])) from GENESIS; verifyJournal replays and names the exact failing seq.
parts.gate: verifyJournal ok after clean run; tamper detected AND localized at exact row (selftest rows)
parts.failure_mode: a silent rewrite would forge the field's history

parts.name: rhizome prior (amplitude-weighted vote)
parts.essence: pure, non-mutating sense-time aggregate: observed op votes weighted by cell gamma/(aSum)/(1+hexDist) within radius 2; uniform fallback when no mass.
parts.gate: total<=0 falls back to uniform 1/7 (no crash, no invention)
parts.failure_mode: empty memory must degrade to honest uniform, not garbage

parts.name: counted memory prior (A1 addendum)
parts.essence: priorCounted: add-1 smoothed exact-context counts, falling back to the global observed distribution — the payload the P-G2d +13.41pp and the A9/A10/A12 fresh-serve laws ride on.
parts.gate: unseen context uses the global observed distribution, never zeros
parts.failure_mode: exact-context memorisation does not transfer across circuit families (P-G2b FAIL of record)

parts.name: sense table serialization (weave-2)
parts.essence: the compact order-free serialization of everything prior() consumes — cells with >=1 observed context carry r6(G), r6(aSum); supervision aggregate sorted bytewise — so the weave artifact can carry the living-memory arm.
parts.gate: byte-deterministic under canonicalJSON (sorted contexts, sorted ops, r6)
parts.failure_mode: nondeterministic serialization would break P-G5 cross-substrate identity

parts.name: qthe prototype arm
parts.essence: growth is adding prototype cells keyed op|yR|yI (integer split-channel QTHE aggregation) — no gradients anywhere; judgment = distance-weighted prototype vote blended with the abstain wormhole.
outputs: prototype list + wormhole; judgeQthe probability table
parts.gate: zero-score tie falls back to honest uniform (tie flag returned)
parts.failure_mode: overflow impossible — integers packed into tau:2+d:6 bytes

parts.name: hash-arm SGD head
parts.essence: softmax over 2^11 hashed n-gram buckets trained by zero-dep JS SGD with sealed HYP (lr 0.5, epochs 12, wd 1e-4, clip 5) — torch-shaped, torch-free, epoch-quantised weights.
parts.gate: deterministic: zero-init weights, no RNG (selftest 'trainHash deterministic')
parts.failure_mode: float drift across substrates — contained by r6 epoch quantisation

parts.name: bigram floor + sealed ensemble lambda
parts.essence: bigram transition counts are the honest enemy floor; ens = lambda*p_head + (1-lambda)*p_rhizome with lambda sealed at 0.5 BEFORE the run to price the kinda-both claim.
parts.gate: ENS_LAMBDA=0.5 sealed in PREDICTIONS.md before the run (decision rules before the run)
parts.failure_mode: post-hoc lambda tuning would invalidate the bake-off — honest FAILs (P-G2/b/c) are receipted instead

parts.name: feature builders
parts.essence: K=3 context window tokens, qthePack byte packing (tau:2 timbre + d:6 coordinate) with position weights [4,2,1], hashFeatures into 2^11 buckets L2-normalised.
outputs: tokens, qthe bytes, sparse feature vectors
parts.gate: K=3 window sealed (selftest 'K=3 window sealed'); hash features L2-normalised and deterministic
parts.failure_mode: an unsealed window size would silently change the meaning of 'context'

parts.name: grow stream law
parts.essence: one deformation per judgment event + one observation per labeled receipt — the watch->deform->observe loop that makes the garden grow from what flows through the quilt.
parts.gate: every stream sample does exactly one deform and one observe
parts.failure_mode: observing without judging (or vice versa) would desync memory from supervision

parts.name: paired-arm evaluation
parts.essence: all five arms (bigram, qthe, hash, field, ens) judged on the same sealed samples — paired arms, identical worlds.
parts.gate: arms differ only in the mechanism under test; identical sample list for every arm
parts.failure_mode: unequal worlds would let an arm win by soil, not by mechanism

parts.name: promotion gate (jeviter lifecycle)
parts.essence: challenger vs incumbent on the sealed eval slice: PROMOTE iff top-1 improves >= +0.02 absolute AND no tracked metric (hash, ens) degrades > 0.05; no incumbent -> PROMOTE (first fruit); ties -> REVIEW; DISCARD is receipted and kept in the journal.
parts.gate: gain >= +0.02 to promote; any tracked gain < -0.05 discards
parts.failure_mode: a degraded weave promoted would poison serving; saturated soil honestly yields REVIEW/DISCARD (P-G2c lambda*=0)

parts.name: weave artifact v1 compilation
parts.essence: self-contained JSON artifact (schema jev-garden/weave-v1): sparse hash weights, qthe prototypes+wormhole, sealed hypers, evalMetrics, gate verdict — floats r6, canonical JSON, sha256-sealed.
parts.gate: artifact_sha256 = sha256(canonicalJSON(artifact)); journal_tip chain-tips the artifact to the journal that produced it
parts.failure_mode: an artifact without its journal tip could not be traced to its growth history

parts.name: weave artifact v2 (sense table rides)
parts.essence: same training laws as v1 (byte-identical hash/qthe arms) plus arms.field = the serialized rhizome sense table; registered serve ensemble ens3 = 0.4*hash + 0.4*qthe + 0.2*field.
parts.gate: schema jev-garden/weave-v2; registered weights only (wh/wq/wf)
parts.failure_mode: the registered ens3 blend FAILED on saturated eval (P-W2b verdict of record, -0.0077) — served only as opt-in

parts.name: loadWeave fail-closed schema gate
parts.essence: serve refuses unknown weave schemas; rebuilds sparse weights to Float64Array; attaches sense-table prior and opt-in mode flags (A7/A8/A9/A10/A12/A13) only when the artifact pre-registers them.
parts.gate: unknown weave schema -> throw 'refuse: unknown weave schema'
parts.failure_mode: silently loading a foreign artifact would serve unsealed weights

parts.name: judge branch law (registered order)
parts.essence: served expression selected in registered order A7 -> A12 -> A10 -> A9 -> A8 -> default v1 (strictest-freshest wins); default is the v1 law ens2 = 0.5*hash + 0.5*qthe; answers carry choice/noul/score + confidence + full probability table.
inputs: loaded weave, state context, questions, judged row
outputs: systemone answers + escalate flag + usage tag
parts.gate: gate-closed paths serve the byte-identical v1 expression; opt-in modes change nothing without their artifact flag
parts.failure_mode: an ungated mode flipping a saturated judgment — exactly what P-A8 priced (gate opened 11/259 saturated calls, registered FAIL branch executed)

parts.name: escalation budget organ (A13)
parts.essence: the organ holds the lane's spend authority for ONE production walk: the first cap honest escalate signals are granted, later ones refused and COUNTED with reason budget_exhausted — never swallowed; it consumes only the signal, never the served bytes.
parts.gate: non-integer or negative cap throws at construction (fail-closed), not mid-walk
parts.failure_mode: a capped organ that perturbed judge() could launder budget policy into judgment

parts.name: escalation threshold (sealed 0.55)
parts.essence: ESCALATE_BELOW = 0.55 sealed constant: escalate = top.p < 0.55 — the honest local signal that low-confidence judgments leave the garden.
parts.gate: threshold constant sealed, reused as H* by the A8/A9 gated modes
parts.failure_mode: a per-row gate cannot guarantee whole-slice closure (P-A8b: 11/259 saturated opens)

parts.name: teacher bridge (escalation organ wire)
parts.essence: the ONLY networked module: hosted JEV (jev-latest, systemone wire) called with the caller's key; returns a usage receipt (model, tokens, latency) that the caller appends to the growth journal — gifted compute leaves receipts.
parts.gate: missing TYPESAFE_API_KEY -> fail-closed throw ('teacher channel closed'); HTTP error surfaces status + body
parts.failure_mode: an unkeyed or silent teacher call would be an unauditable spend

parts.name: qcells soil adapter
parts.essence: turns the real quilt-qcells CELL-MAPPING ledgers into garden judgment streams: byte-order-sorted 12 train / 4 eval ledger split, sample building (k-context -> next opcode).
parts.gate: split is byte-order sorted and sealed (selftest 'split: 12 train / 4 eval', 'split is byte-order sorted')
parts.failure_mode: an unsealed split would let eval soil leak into training

parts.name: impact-sensitive anomaly injection
parts.essence: Task B corrupts COPIES of eval ledgers with semantic op swaps (BIND->EFFECT), seq breaks, prev-hash breaks, and arg corruption that changes the oracle — clean rows interleaved; originals untouched.
parts.gate: changes are impact-sensitive: op/seq/prev/args actually touched (selftest 'changes are impact-sensitive'); 'original rows untouched'
parts.failure_mode: cosmetic corruption would make the validator's AUC a costume

parts.name: concentration detector + AUC pricing
parts.essence: validator duty uses windowMax — max per-row surprise in a window, NOT the window mean (quilt-jepa design law (b)) — threshold chosen on TRAIN ledgers only; priced by AUC and FPR.
outputs: window max statistic, percentile thresholds, AUC
parts.gate: verdict of record: AUC 0.9294 >= 0.90 AND FPR 0.0353 <= 0.10 (P-G4); semantic-only AUC 0.9539 (P-G4b) with seq/prev delegated to the chain reader
parts.failure_mode: a mean-based window would dilute a single hard corruption — the exact failure design law (b) forbids

cells.expr: on labeled receipt: journal+={kind:'observe'}; observed[ctx][op]++  (the ONLY collapse)
W,b <- 12 epochs SGD(lr=0.5, wd=1e-4, clip=5), r6 per epoch
PROMOTE iff min_gain>=+0.02 AND worst_gain>=-0.05; else REVIEW/DISCARD
weaveIfIdle: diff journal -> train challengers -> gate -> artifact{sha256, journal_tip}
teacherJudge -> usage receipt appended to growth journal (fail-closed without key)

layer_logic.0: canonical bytes + lattice: sorted-key canonicalJSON, sha256/fnv1a64, r6 quantisation, 61-cell hex lattice, 7 opcodes, 2^11 feature buckets — every later layer is a pure function of these
layer_logic.1: soft accumulation: deform/observe append alpha-weighted events to a hash-chained journal; rhizome priors, qthe prototypes and SGD heads are all aggregates over that journal; anomalies are injected impact-sensitively
layer_logic.2: sealed policy: lambda=0.5, ESCALATE_BELOW=0.55, promotion gate +0.02/-0.05, registered serve-branch order, A13 budget cap — every constant sealed in registration.json BEFORE the run
layer_logic.3: wires and artifacts: systemone judge endpoint, weave-v1/v2 artifacts (schema-checked fail-closed, chain-tipped), teacher bridge with usage receipts, qcells adapter as real soil
layer_logic.4: tamper-evident evidence: verifyJournal row-exact localization, artifact_sha256, paired-arm evals, windowMax/AUC telemetry, and verdicts of record kept honest (P-G2/b/c FAILs never repaired, only receipted)
